---
title: Convert continuous aggregates to the columnstore
description: Compress a continuous aggregate to the columnstore to save storage space while making sure the data is still available for your analytical workloads
products: [cloud, mst, self_hosted]
keywords: [continuous aggregates, compression]
---

import * as C from "@constants";
import { NumberedList, NumberedItem } from "@components/NumberedList";
import SinceRelease from "@components/SinceRelease.astro";

<SinceRelease version="2.20.0" product="tsdb" />

To save on storage costs, you use {C.HYPERCORE} to downsample historical data stored in {C.CAGG}s. After you
[enable {C.COLUMNSTORE}](/reference/timescaledb/continuous-aggregates/alter_materialized_view) on a `MATERIALIZED VIEW`, you set a
[{C.COLUMNSTORE} policy](/reference/timescaledb/hypercore/add_columnstore_policy). This policy defines the intervals when {C.CHUNK}s in a {C.CAGG}
are compressed as they are converted from the {C.ROWSTORE} to the {C.COLUMNSTORE}.

{C.COLUMNSTORE_CAP} works in the same way on [{C.HYPERTABLE}s and {C.CAGG}s](/build/columnar-storage). When you enable
{C.COLUMNSTORE} with no other options, your data is [segmented by](/reference/timescaledb/continuous-aggregates/alter_materialized_view#arguments) the `groupby` columns
in the {C.CAGG}, and [ordered by](/reference/timescaledb/continuous-aggregates/alter_materialized_view#arguments) the time column. [{C.RTAGG_CAP}](/build/continuous-aggregates/real-time-aggregates)
is disabled by default.

## Configure {C.COLUMNSTORE} on {C.CAGG}s

For an [existing {C.CAGG}](/build/continuous-aggregates/create-a-continuous-aggregate):

<NumberedList>
<NumberedItem title={`Enable ${C.COLUMNSTORE} on a ${C.CAGG}`}>
Set `timescaledb.enable_columnstore = true` when you alter the view:

```sql
ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW <cagg_name> set (timescaledb.enable_columnstore = true);
```

To disable the {C.COLUMNSTORE}, set `timescaledb.enable_columnstore = false`.
</NumberedItem>

<NumberedItem title={`Set ${C.COLUMNSTORE} policies on the ${C.CAGG}`}>
Before you set up a {C.COLUMNSTORE} policy on a {C.CAGG}, you first set the [refresh policy](/build/continuous-aggregates/refresh-policies). To
prevent refresh policies from failing, set the {C.COLUMNSTORE} policy interval so that actively
refreshed regions are not compressed. For example:

<ol type="a">
<li>

Set the refresh policy:

```sql
SELECT add_continuous_aggregate_policy('<cagg_name>',
  start_offset => INTERVAL '30 days',
  end_offset => INTERVAL '1 day',
  schedule_interval => INTERVAL '1 hour');
```

</li>
<li>

Set the {C.COLUMNSTORE} policy. The `after` parameter must be greater than the value of
`start_offset` in the refresh policy:

```sql
CALL add_columnstore_policy('<cagg_name>', after => INTERVAL '45 days');
```

</li>
</ol>
</NumberedItem>
</NumberedList>
